# Re-entry Navigation Case Plan: Javis Foster

## 1. Immediate Stabilization & Crisis Intervention
**CRITICAL ACTION:** Javis disclosed suicidal ideation ("Sometimes it comes contemplate suicide"). 
*   **Action:** Immediate mental health triage. Create a safety plan today. Provide crisis hotline information (988) and refer for a clinical assessment.
*   **Relapse Prevention:** He has been clean for 9 months from opiates/benzos. The stress of pending charges and financial strain is a high trigger for relapse. Build a structured relapse prevention plan.

## 2. CBT & Facilitation Focus (Turn90 Standards)
*   **Target:** Externalization of Blame & Minimization.
*   **Strategy (Modeling Neutrality 1.5):** Javis minimizes his actions (e.g., claiming lack of sleep caused his crime, minimizing his evading charge). Do not debate his version of events. Use open-ended, reflective questions: *"You mentioned you ran through someone's house to get away. Walk me through what was going through your mind in that exact moment."*
*   **Managing Buy-In (3.2):** Link every requirement to his goal of providing for his child and partner. *"Getting your GED and addressing these pending charges head-on is the fastest way to get to that $20/hr mark to support your family."*

## 3. Barrier Removal & Navigation
*   **Education:** Connect Javis to GED classes immediately. He has an active license, SSN, and birth certificate, which removes a major hurdle for employment.
*   **Legal:** He has pending charges (Burglary 2nd, Evading). Ensure he is connected to his public defender and complies strictly with any pretrial supervision conditions to prevent pre-trial detention.
*   **Employment:** Prep him for fair-chance manufacturing roles in the Upstate (Greenville/Greer) area. Since he has stable transportation (active license), regional commutes are viable.

## 4. Weekly Milestones for Navigator
*   **Week 1:** Mental health safety plan, referral to counseling, and connection to GED prep program.
*   **Week 2:** Review legal status of pending charges; begin CBT workbook exercises on "Thinking Traps" (minimization).
*   **Week 3:** Mock interviews focusing on how to explain past convictions and pending charges professionally.
*   **Week 4:** Submit applications to Fair-Chance employers in Upstate SC.

# My Fresh Start Action & Resource Guide: Javis Foster

Welcome to your Fresh Start, Javis! You have already made massive strides—staying clean for over nine months, keeping a stable address, and having all your vital IDs ready to go. You’ve expressed a strong desire to live a life without crime, support your child, and get a solid career. This guide is built to help you turn those goals into reality by providing local Spartanburg/Greenville resources and high-paying career tracks.

## 🌟 Your Immediate Action Steps (4-Week Checklist)

**Week 1: Health & Stability First**
- [ ] **Talk to Someone:** You mentioned feeling down and having tough thoughts. Please reach out to a professional or let us connect you to a counselor. Your mental health is the foundation of your success. (Call or text 988 anytime for immediate support).
- [ ] **Legal Check-In:** Review your pending charges with your attorney/public defender so you know exactly what your court dates and requirements are.

**Week 2: Education & Skills**
- [ ] **GED Next Steps:** Contact United Ministries (info below) to get enrolled in a fast-track GED program. Having that paper opens up higher pay brackets.
- [ ] **Relapse Prevention:** Continue building your support network to ensure you stay strong in your 9-month clean time, even when stressed.

**Week 3: Career Prep**
- [ ] **Resume Building:** Work with Turn90 staff to build a resume that highlights your reliability and readiness to work.
- [ ] **Interview Practice:** Practice how to talk about your background and your growth honestly and professionally.

**Week 4: Apply & Launch**
- [ ] **Apply for Jobs:** Submit applications to the Fair-Chance employers listed below in the Upstate.
- [ ] **Plan Your Commute:** Map out your drive from Spartanburg to Greer or Greenville for your new job.

---

## 🛠️ Local Community Resources (Upstate SC)

**Mental Health & Recovery Support**
*   **The Phoenix Center**
    *   *Services:* Outpatient counseling and addiction recovery support to help you manage stress and stay on track.
    *   *Contact:* (864) 467-3790 | 1400 Cleveland St, Greenville, SC
    *   *Links:* [Visit Website](https://phoenixcenter.org) | [Directions](https://maps.google.com/?q=1400+Cleveland+St,+Greenville,+SC+29607)

**Education & Employment Prep**
*   **United Ministries**
    *   *Services:* Job training, life coaching, and adult education/GED assistance.
    *   *Contact:* (864) 232-6463 | 606 Pendleton St, Greenville, SC
    *   *Links:* [Visit Website](https://united-ministries.com) | [Directions](https://maps.google.com/?q=606+Pendleton+St,+Greenville,+SC+29601)

**Fatherhood & Family Support**
*   **Upstate Fatherhood Initiative**
    *   *Services:* Job readiness, child support assistance, and fatherhood programs.
    *   *Contact:* (864) 244-9333 | 201 E Broad St, Suite 200, Greenville, SC
    *   *Links:* [Visit Website](https://scfathersandfamilies.com) | [Directions](https://maps.google.com/?q=201+E+Broad+St,+Suite+200,+Greenville,+SC+29601)

---

## 💼 Targeted Fair-Chance Job Matches

**1. Upstate Precision Manufacturing**
*   **Role:** CNC Machine Operator Trainee / Material Handler
*   **Pay:** $18.50 – $23.00 / hr
*   **Shift:** 1st & 2nd Shifts Available
*   **Why it fits:** Located in Greer/Greenville (a very short drive from Spartanburg). They offer on-the-job machine training, which doesn't require prior experience, and they partner with re-entry programs. This is a great place to start a long-term career.
*   **Action:** [Apply Online / View Careers Page](https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=manufacturing+machine+operator&l=Greenville%2C+SC)

**2. Foothills Structural Steel & Welding**
*   **Role:** Welder Apprentice / Structural Steel Helper
*   **Pay:** $19.50 – $26.00 / hr
*   **Shift:** 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM (M–F)
*   **Why it fits:** Offers an apprenticeship certification path. You mentioned working on your GED—this company focuses on skilled trades and hands-on work, making it perfect for building a solid, high-paying career from the ground up.
*   **Action:** [Apply Online / View Careers Page](https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=structural+welder&l=Greenville%2C+SC)

*Keep your head up, Javis. You have the tools and the drive to build a great life for yourself and your family. We are here to support you every step of the way!*
